pairs: Alleluja.
Alleluia.
Laudate, pueri,
Praise the Lord,
Dominum;
children.
laudate nomen Domini.
Praise the name of the Lord.
Sit nomen Domini benedictum ex hoc nunc
Blessed is the name of the Lord,
et usque in sæculum.
from this time forward and even forever.
A solis ortu usque ad occasum laudabile nomen Domini.
From the rising of the sun, even to its setting, praiseworthy is the name of the Lord.
Excelsus super omnes gentes Dominus,
The Lord is high above all nations,
et super cælos gloria ejus.
and his glory is high above the heavens.
Quis sicut Dominus Deus noster,
Who is like the Lord, our God,
qui in altis habitat,
who dwells on high,
et humilia respicit in cælo et in terra?
and who gazes upon the humble things in heaven and on earth?
Suscitans a terra inopem,
He lifts up the needy from the ground,
et de stercore erigens pauperem:
and he urges the poor away from filth,
ut collocet eum cum principibus,
so that he may place him with the leaders,
cum principibus populi sui.
with the leaders of his people.
Qui habitare facit sterilem in domo,
He causes a barren woman to live in a house,
matrem filiorum lætantem.
as the joyful mother of sons.
